With more than 15 years of experience in the local property market, we have been supporting local & international clients in finding quality homes across Hanoi, especially in key residential areas such as Ciputra, Tây Hồ, Ba Đình, and surrounding districts. Our team of dedicated real estate consultants and customer service professionals is committed to delivering reliable, responsive, and personalized support to every client. Today, with a team of more than 15 experienced staff members, Vietlong Housing continues to build a strong reputation based on professionalism, market expertise, and long-term client relationships. Our Services • Home Search Consultancy • Property Leasing & Rental Support • Property Evaluation • Property Management Services Our Mission At Vietlong Housing, our mission is to provide high-quality real estate services tailored to the needs of expatriates living and working in Hanoi. We are committed to: • Delivering professional and reliable support • Building long-term relationships with our clients • Responding quickly and efficiently to customer requests • Achieving the highest level of customer satisfaction • Continuously improving our services and expertise We believe that every member of our company plays an important role in creating a positive experience for our clients. Teamwork, dedication, and integrity are at the core of everything we do. Our Vision Our vision is to become Hanoi’s leading real estate agency for expatriate housing by developing a highly trained, proactive, and customer-focused team that is always ready to support clients with professionalism and care. At Vietlong Housing, client satisfaction is always our top priority.
